author: j. s. fields
title: Miami to face Louisville in ACC men's basketball tournament quarterfinals
text:
The Miami men’s basketball team will play against Louisville in the quarterfinals of the 2026 T. Rowe Price Atlantic Coast Conference (ACC) Men’s Basketball Tournament, according to a March 11 announcement. The game is scheduled for 2:30 p.m. on March 12 in Charlotte, North Carolina.
The Hurricanes enter the tournament with a record of 24 wins and 7 losses overall, including a 13-5 mark in ACC play. This performance secured them the No. 3 seed and tied the school record for most regular season wins.
Three Miami players received All-ACC honors this season: Malik Reneau was named to the First Team, Tre Donaldson earned Second Team recognition, and Ernest Udeh Jr. was selected for the Defensive Team. Head coach Jai Lucas achieved his twentieth win faster than all but one first-time head coach in ACC history.
Miami leads the ACC in field goal percentage at 50.4 percent, which also ranks eleventh nationally. Reneau has scored at least twenty points in sixteen games this season and averages a team-high of 19.1 points per game.
The Hurricanes will look to continue their strong performance as they advance into postseason play.
